snippet.title: ROBLOX DS/OpenBLOX: Player Movement Prototype [Tech Demo]
snippet.description:
So, I spent pretty much all day getting it this complete, despite the lack of horizontal collision detection, it works for the most part.
The game loads the character.rbxm file located in content/fonts, as well, since I'm going to attempt to mimic the File Structure ROBLOX itself used at the time; I also got culling fully functional, objects in the distance ~64+ studs away, unless they are big enough, pop out of view, ill try adding fog maybe, or some fading effect, the game is a bit more intensive now.
Yeah its still jank as hell, but it does work to an extent; as said.

Project Discord: https://discord.gg/Wf2bbU5z5J
Project Github: https://github.com/EGAMatsu/OpenBLOX

#roblox #nintendods #ds #game #prototype #gamedev #cplusplusprogramming #cplusplus #oldroblox #firsttimeintheworld
